title: ForceZero on init_op after every cipher/HMAC operation
description: crypto2dev_cipher (port.c:804) and crypto2dev_hmac (port.c:1101) call ForceZero(&init_op, sizeof(init_op)) at the done: label even when successful. init_op contains the inline AES/HMAC key bytes (up to 128 bytes). The ForceZero is correct even though init_op is stack-allocated: it prevents the key from surviving in compiler-optimized spill slots or residual stack frames. A contributor might argue 'the compiler will optimize this out' — it won't if properly annotated (ForceZero uses volatile). Should be kept even if it looks redundant.
